meta.notes: Where scripts/import-base-directories.mjs goes to find the agencies MilitaryINSTALLATIONS does not publish per installation. `sites` is written by `--discover`: a hostname is guessed from the installation's slug, fetched, and kept only if the page it serves names the installation back — `title` is the page title that was read, and is the evidence for the entry. A guessed hostname that fails that check is discarded, so an installation with no entry here simply has no site the importer could confirm; nothing is assumed from the name. `extraHosts` seeds candidates for installations whose site is not derivable from the slug (Davis-Monthan is www.dm.af.mil, Wright-Patterson is www.wpafb.af.mil). Those are candidates only: they go through the same title check as every other guess. `pageHints` are matched against link text to decide which of a site's pages are worth reading. Widening either list is a data edit here — the importer names no host and no page itself.
